items.description: Leonida Is A Native PC Recompilation Of The Xbox Version Of Grand Theft Auto 6

items.name: rust-anything
items.description: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.

items.name: blender-ai-mcp-addon
items.description: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with ChatGPT/GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.

items.name: fast-anything
items.description: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile Python, Node or Ruby apps, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same.

items.name: neonclipping
items.description: Paste a link, get captioned 9:16 clips in ~2 min. Free, local, open-source clipping engine (audio-first, YouTube captions, local LLM).

items.name: inference-optimisation-skill
items.description: Agent skill for hill-climbing local LLM serving speed (decode, speculative decoding, prefill, KV, startup, TTFT) on any hardware and quantization

items.name: xbox-emulator
items.description: Progress notes for running Xbox Series X|S builds on PC (TomBox + rage9)

items.name: Xbox2Windows
items.description: GTA VI static recompilation research for x64 Windows. Source-built EXEs run on Windows, and two translated pixel shaders match reference outputs on hardware and WARP. Full-game startup is unverified.

items.name: WinRust
items.description: Windows shell replacement in Rust: taskbar, file manager, NTFS search, task manager, disk cleaner. One installer exe.

items.name: mobile-agent-testers
items.description: 20 AI testers on 20 different phones, in parallel, on GitHub's free runners: Claude Code agents on iOS Simulators and Android emulators that find broken flows, translation, layout and accessibility bugs
